purpose: Paise-only money value object used for all backend financial arithmetic.
businessRules: All money is represented as long paise.
No float, double, BigDecimal, rupee string, or client-computed amount is accepted as money truth.
Arithmetic uses exact operations to surface overflow instead of silently wrapping.
aiHint: Do not add rupee factories. Formatting belongs to presentation clients; backend APIs expose paise explicitly.
